cristal-den/enforcer-host.about-enforcers: You're in the HQ of the town's police force. We protect the Den from outside and inside threats. If you go looking for trouble, we're the one making sure you'll find it.
cristal-den/enforcer-host.about-messing-around: Why would you think I'm looking for trouble ?
cristal-den/enforcer-host.about-work: Maybe. Talk to Captain Sentry. She's downstairs.
cristal-den/enforcer-host.ask-about-work: I'm looking for work. You ponies need any help ?
cristal-den/enforcer-host.on-trouble: I'm just saying. Don't take it the wrong way. We have to be careful about everypony here. There's a lot of tension around here.
cristal-den/enforcer-host.on-trouble-bad-rep: It's our job to know what goes around in this town. You've made a name for yourself here, and not for the good reasons. You'd best watch your steps when you're around us.
cristal-den/enforcer-host.on-trouble-slavers-wiped-out: Well, you did wipe out the slavers. That was quite a ballsy move. Good thing Captain Sentry told us not to intervene. I guess she never really liked those pricks. The Potioks might disapprove, but Captain does what Captain wants.
